notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes:
Release

Our game is finally released! 
To celebrate the release, we started a 40% discount for 2 weeks, so do not miss your chance to obtain your dream stepsister :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576486/5e38326152af251bdb20bbfe4b8cc8d068dc7b7e.gif

Workshop

We also want to let you know that our game support workshop for custom voice packs, if you want to know how use the workshop check out our guide here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3475452111

And to see available workshop voice packs:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/3615360/workshop/


We look forward to seeing your voice packs!

Contacts

If you have any questions or suggestions, contact us at gosdevproduction@gmail.com

Don't forget to also subscribe to our development group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev

And curatorial group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev

To make sure you don't miss new releases!
